answer_1.quote: We use VVMAs to speed up inference in the computationally expensive Neural Machine Translation (NMT) task by a factor of four without losing much in terms of quality.

answer_2.quote: For German-English, the original model had 61.4M parameters and an uncased test BLEU score of 29.66. The VVMA model had 37M parameters and a BLEU score of 28.5.
